description: Jest service fixture should preserve the native test command, extend existing parser tests, add service coverage, and defer DTO-only models.

lockedFields.reason: The plan should keep the repository's discovered Jest verification command.
The untested service boundary should be one add-test candidate.
The existing parser spec should be extended rather than duplicated.
DTO-only code should be deferred from direct test generation.
Existing parser tests should remain the highest-value first recommendation.
Parser logic should be covered with focused unit tests.
The planner should reuse the existing Jest spec file convention.
The service boundary should be recommended for a new native unit test.
DTO-only models should stay deferred rather than becoming direct test targets.
Deferred DTO-only targets should not request a direct test level.

allowedVariations: Rationale wording may change if it keeps the same native Jest strategy.
Additional non-locked metadata may be added.
unexpectedVariations: Replacing the discovered Jest command with another verification command.
Generating a direct DTO test recommendation.
Dropping the existing parser spec path.
Changing the add, extend, or defer counts for this fixture.
